title: Late Initial Deposit Points — Outpatient Surgery Package Terms (Good Faith & Price Estimates)
content:
Term of the Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Outpatient Surgery under Good Faith & Price Estimates: an initial deposit paid long after the booking was scheduled carries added percentage points.

**Term.** The days since scheduling run from the scheduling date of the estimate to today's date, the scheduling date not counted and today counted. Sixty or more days since scheduling add ten percentage points (10) to the booking's deposit percentage; thirty to fifty-nine days add five percentage points (5); fewer than thirty days add none, a scheduling date later than today's date counting as zero days. The points are added to the booking's deposit percentage before that percentage is applied.

| Days since scheduling | Percentage points added |
|---|---|
| 60 or more | 10 |
| 30 to 59 | 5 |
| 0 to 29 | none |
| scheduling date after today (counted as 0) | none |

## Boundaries (hypothetical)

- Scheduled 59 days before today: 5 points. Scheduled 60 days before today: 10 points.
- Scheduled 29 days before today: no points. Scheduled 30 days before today: 5 points.
